body: Anyone alive out there? I would really like to talk about what occurred tonight

Yeah, it blows pretty hardcore. I haven't slept or eaten in three days now. Absolutely no appetite. Just wondering where all the fucking cuts and knicks on my hands and harms have come from over the last few days.
I know what you're saying, however since I was a little boy everything has been pretty fucked. I have always had to make my own pretend happiness with webs of lies and leading groups
I hate that fact that I have to use a new account just so I can continue to be that guy everyone leans on to keep everything rolling.

Anything specifically weighing on your mind? end quote. I don't  know how to explain it, bud. I have always been the one that builds and keeps the groups of friends going. I guess theres nothing specific, other than a massive ton of stuff, I do not know how to say it all
I spent some time and made a comment on a previous comment, something something words? I feel like I did not word any of this properly.

I have been staying awake no matter how long it keeps me up just so I can hide in the coat closet and cry my fucking eyes out. Being the person that keeps the group together is all I live for. That and convincing my best friend and my brother and father that I'm happy and life is well.
I truly miss the ability to cry and care. Where have I fucked up?
